named_subject: a penguin-like bird with a round head, pointed beak, oval body with a belly patch, and two wings
action: The bird stands in place, sways its head slightly side to side, and opens and closes its beak as if talking, matching the film's talking penguin.
identity_gap: The animated bird uses the same round head, triangular beak, loop-in-loop body and side wing shapes as the doodle, though it is tilted and the beak shape changes more than the doodle suggests.
notes: The beak opening and small head sway follow the film's talking motion, but the body stays upright-leaning-left while the film figure leans diagonally, and frames 13 to 16 show the head and beak jumping in position and shape (the beak shrinks to a thin line in 16). The change that would help most is easing the head and beak between poses in frames 12 to 16 so the beak changes size gradually instead of popping.
